text_block_list.text:
Эль Кондор Паса defeats Сайленс Судзука.
This time,
she keeps her feet firmly
planted after her
victory.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
While congratulating her, Silence
Suzuka tells El
Condor Pasa that she has
the ability to turn the
cheers of her fans
into strength.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
This puzzles Эль Кондор Паса, since she
believes all
runners have the same
ability.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She ruminates on Сайленс Судзука's words
and
heads toward the Japan Cup.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
